purpose: Bind runtime/ABI/FFI authority-boundary evidence to exact executed inputs and scope while preserving the hard distinction between provenance/evidence and live effect authority.
existing_laws_reused: effect.commit requires independently valid capability possession and witnesses

execution.platform_fingerprint: OS/kernel/arch/runtime versions sufficient for the gate
execution.started_at: timestamp optional for semantics but useful for audit
execution.finished_at: timestamp optional for semantics but useful for audit

test_result.positive_checks: explicit named checks or digest-bound result object
test_result.negative_controls: explicit named checks; authority rejection tests mandatory for effect gates

evidence_scope.counts_as_target_acceptance: Boolean fixed by gate policy, never inferred from platform name

required_receipt.external_attestation_ref: optional signed in-toto/SLSA/GitHub artifact-attestation reference; strengthens builder provenance but is not execution authority

capability_authority_contract.preferred_base_shape: runtime-minted opaque live handle bound to runtime instance, kind, epoch/revocation state and broker registry
capability_authority_contract.cross_process_rule: If BASE/FRANK requires authority to cross an isolated process or component boundary, lower through a broker/table/OS-handle mechanism that preserves unforgeability and lifetime. Do not upgrade a Clay capability-shaped record into authority by parsing it.
capability_authority_contract.cross_component_reference: WASI-style resource-handle tables are an external precedent, not a required implementation.

github_ci_candidate.plain_receipt_minimum: Always generate the project GateExecutionReceipt with exact hashes and scope, commit/store it only after tests complete successfully, then verify before admission.
github_ci_candidate.signed_attestation_optional_layer: Where repository/plan policy permits, GitHub artifact attestations may bind a built executable/artifact to workflow/repository/commit provenance. Signed provenance augments but does not replace the project gate receipt or authority tests.

andreas_target_candidate.rule: Re-run the same digest-bound runtime/ABI/FFI and negative-authority suite on the actual target host. The resulting receipt may share subject/material digests with hosted CI but must carry target-host execution identity and must be independently verified before target acceptance.

next_discriminating_tests: Run current tools/claycode_base_runtime_validation.py against the exact current runtime blob on hosted Ubuntu and materialize a digest-bound proxy receipt.
Mutate runtime source after a passing receipt and prove admission rejects the stale receipt.
Mutate validation suite/workflow after a passing receipt and prove admission rejects stale evidence.
Feed a valid attestation object to the effect adapter in place of CapabilityHandle and prove rejection.
Execute identical digest-bound suite on Andreas target host and compare behavior while keeping evidence scopes distinct.
If an isolated FFI/process boundary actually requires authority transfer, implement and fuzz a broker/table handle lowering; otherwise preserve process-local opacity for BASE.
promotion_guard: Candidate belongs in compiler/runtime/CI/admission infrastructure first. Do not change ClayCode core syntax unless an executable application or FRANK counterexample proves the existing semantic contract insufficient.
